search.query: | tstats count as flow_events, latest(Flow_Status.controllerStatus.activeThreadCount) as active_threads, latest(Flow_Status.controllerStatus.bytesQueued) as bytes_queued, latest(Flow_Status.controllerStatus.flowFilesQueued) as flowfiles_queued, latest(Flow_Status.controllerStatus.runningCount) as running, latest(Flow_Status.controllerStatus.stoppedCount) as stopped, latest(Flow_Status.controllerStatus.disabledCount) as disabled, latest(Flow_Status.controllerStatus.invalidCount) as invalid, latest(Flow_Status.controllerStatus.upToDateCount) as up_to_date, latest(Flow_Status.controllerStatus.locallyModifiedCount) as locally_modified, latest(Flow_Status.controllerStatus.staleCount) as stale, latest(Flow_Status.controllerStatus.locallyModifiedAndStaleCount) as modified_and_stale, latest(Flow_Status.controllerStatus.syncFailureCount) as sync_failure, latest(Flow_Status.controllerStatus.activeRemotePortCount) as transmitting, latest(Flow_Status.controllerStatus.inactiveRemotePortCount) as not_transmitting from datamodel=NIFI.Flow_Status by host | append [| tstats count as bulletin_errors from datamodel=NIFI.Reporting_Bulletin by host] | append [| inputlookup instance | fields host, cluster | eval configured = 1] | stats max(flow_events) as flow_events, max(active_threads) as active_threads, max(bytes_queued) as bytes_queued, max(flowfiles_queued) as flowfiles_queued, max(running) as running, max(stopped) as stopped, max(disabled) as disabled, max(invalid) as invalid, max(up_to_date) as up_to_date, max(locally_modified) as locally_modified, max(stale) as stale, max(modified_and_stale) as modified_and_stale, max(sync_failure) as sync_failure, max(transmitting) as transmitting, max(not_transmitting) as not_transmitting, max(bulletin_errors) as bulletin_errors, values(cluster) as cluster, max(configured) as configured by host | eval status = if(flow_events > 0, "Up", "Down") | eval "Total Queued Data" = flowfiles_queued . " / " . bytes_queued . " bytes" | fillnull value=0 bulletin_errors | rename active_threads as "Active Threads", transmitting as "Transmitting Remote Process Group", not_transmitting as "Not Transmitting Remote Process Group", running as "Running Components", stopped as "Stopped Components", invalid as "Invalid Components", disabled as "Disabled Components", up_to_date as "Up To Date Versioned Process Group", locally_modified as "Locally Modified Versioned Process Group", stale as "Stale Versioned Process Group", modified_and_stale as "Locally Modified And Stale Versioned Process Group", sync_failure as "Sync Failure Versioned Process Group", bulletin_errors as "Bulletin Errors" | sort + status, cluster, host | table host cluster status "Active Threads" "Total Queued Data" "Transmitting Remote Process Group" "Not Transmitting Remote Process Group" "Running Components" "Stopped Components" "Invalid Components" "Disabled Components" "Up To Date Versioned Process Group" "Locally Modified Versioned Process Group" "Stale Versioned Process Group" "Locally Modified And Stale Versioned Process Group" "Sync Failure Versioned Process Group" "Bulletin Errors"

| tstats latest(System_Diagnostics.systemDiagnostics.aggregateSnapshot.contentRepositoryStorageUsage.usedSpaceBytes) as content_used, latest(System_Diagnostics.systemDiagnostics.aggregateSnapshot.contentRepositoryStorageUsage.totalSpaceBytes) as content_total, latest(System_Diagnostics.systemDiagnostics.aggregateSnapshot.flowFileRepositoryStorageUsage.usedSpaceBytes) as flow_used, latest(System_Diagnostics.systemDiagnostics.aggregateSnapshot.flowFileRepositoryStorageUsage.totalSpaceBytes) as flow_total, latest(System_Diagnostics.systemDiagnostics.aggregateSnapshot.provenanceRepositoryStorageUsage.usedSpaceBytes) as prov_used, latest(System_Diagnostics.systemDiagnostics.aggregateSnapshot.provenanceRepositoryStorageUsage.totalSpaceBytes) as prov_total from datamodel=NIFI.System_Diagnostics by host | append [| inputlookup instance | fields host, cluster | eval configured = 1] | stats max(content_used) as content_used, max(content_total) as content_total, max(flow_used) as flow_used, max(flow_total) as flow_total, max(prov_used) as prov_used, max(prov_total) as prov_total, values(cluster) as cluster, max(configured) as configured by host | eval "Content Used GB" = round(content_used / 1073741824, 2), "Content Total GB" = round(content_total / 1073741824, 2), "Content %" = round(content_used / content_total * 100, 1), "Flow Used GB" = round(flow_used / 1073741824, 2), "Flow Total GB" = round(flow_total / 1073741824, 2), "Flow %" = round(flow_used / flow_total * 100, 1), "Provenance Used GB" = round(prov_used / 1073741824, 2), "Provenance Total GB" = round(prov_total / 1073741824, 2), "Provenance %" = round(prov_used / prov_total * 100, 1) | sort + cluster, host | table host cluster "Content Used GB" "Content Total GB" "Content %" "Flow Used GB" "Flow Total GB" "Flow %" "Provenance Used GB" "Provenance Total GB" "Provenance %"
| tstats count from datamodel=NIFI.Reporting_Bulletin groupby _time host span=1m | timechart sum(count) by host span=5m | fillnull value=0
